paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between loss and epoch for two types of data. The x-axis represents epoch, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked with ticks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents loss, with a linear scale ranging from 0.50 to 2.25, marked with ticks at intervals of 0.25. The plot features two lines: one in blue, representing Train, starts at approximately 1.80 at epoch 0, then decreases to around 0.55 at epoch 30, showing a steady downward trend. The other line, in green, representing Validation, starts at about 1.50 at epoch 0 and fluctuates, peaking at around 2.20 at epoch 10, before decreasing to approximately 1.00 at epoch 30.
